title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions about the platform.

whatIsMasarx.question: What is Masar X?
whatIsMasarx.answer: Masar X is your integrated university learning platform: study materials, lectures, summaries, quizzes & AI tutor — everything you need to study in one place.

approvalProcess.question: Why isn't my summary/exam showing?
approvalProcess.answer: The content may still be under review or not yet approved. Only approved content is shown on public pages.

accountRequired.question: Do I need to create an account?
accountRequired.answer: You can browse without an account, but adding content or interacting with some features may require signing in.

reportIssue.question: How do I report a problem or inappropriate content?
reportIssue.answer: Use the contact/support button inside the platform (if available) or reach out to the administration. We will review the report as soon as possible.
